weeks.shortDescription:
Bex Naj is a Nevada City, CA-based open-format DJ known for her clean
and euphonious mixing, focused attunement to the dancefloor, and
dynamic taste and energy. Her sound is anchored by world bass and
global club, with genre-expansivity that ranges from deep dubstep,
R&B, trap and wave, to organic, deep, and Afro house, amapiano,
reggaeton and dancehall, UK garage, baile funk and dembow, breaks,
trance, hip-hop, and drum & bass.
weeks.bio:
Bex’s spaceholding reflects her deep enthusiasm for articulating the
underlying patterns of nondual philosophy through the laboratory of
embodied research — in other words, moving and breathing together.
She’s here to remind you: this body is your home, your teacher, your
portal. And yes, you’re meant to feel whole through it. Free your ass
and your mind will follow!
weeks.name: Dj Bex Naj
weeks.somaticBlurb: Pancake waffling the worlds of acro and contact dancing

weeks.bio:
NEW DATE, WEDS NOV 25TH Faren Rajkumar AKA Mother Void is a nomadic musician & muse of West Indian ancestry, currently based in the PNW. she celebrates her culture & the Matriarchy through musical expression and commanding the dancefloor.

Mother Void is a classically trained violinist offering DJ sets w/ live violin, acoustic instrumentals, and private instruction. she has been playing violin for over 25 years, and recently developed mixing skills to combine electronic and acoustic sounds for dance.

as a dance journey facilitator/DJ, Mother Void invites bodies to contemplate their inner dark matter and creation center, conjure movement medicine and experience the sacred sensations of sound, vibration, motion, touch and stillness. she is an expert at creating complete dance arc journeys that can take you through the five rhythms, induce powerful awakening & release of suppressed sensual energy, or inspire play with others on the dance floor.
